lines.text: Laban rushed out to the man at the spring and called him blessed by the LORD.
The servant said he was Abraham's servant and that Sarah had borne Abraham a son in her old age.
Abraham made his servant swear not to take a wife for Isaac from the Egyptians, but from his father's house.
Laban and Bethuel said this was from the LORD, and the servant gave jewels and clothing to Rebekah.
Isaac had returned from Beer-sheba, and Rebekah covered herself with a veil when she saw him in the field.
